method.profile: existing release opt-level=3, LTO=true, codegen-units=1; Rust 1.88.0
method.headline_statistic: median of three per-process full-preparation medians; ratios are paired per-process medians
method.timed_operation: actual seal plus source receipts, Arc handle handoff and captured compute metadata; no ICP
method.independent_stage_timers: retained unchanged; not added or subtracted as full attribution

inputs.target: canonical little-endian f32 XYZ, actual assigned-target factory and decoder
inputs.source_pose: frame j=1..3: identity rotation, translation (j,-2*j,0.5); real source admission; actual captured body-to-odom transform
inputs.source_order: reverse accepted frame list; actual helper sorts complete frame key
inputs.interpretation: synthetic finite capacity cohorts; 250k is supported helper-bound control, not ordinary immediate guarded ingress

ownership_evidence.direct_decode_constructor: data pointer and capacity retained by Arc::new(decoded); signed zero preserved; clones share allocation; weak expires after last reader
ownership_evidence.actual_seal: field type assertion, exact source and target coordinate bits, target capacity, source/checkpoint owner identity, lifecycle lock retained until original lease release, last reader remains valid after sealed context release
ownership_evidence.limitation: decode pointer is checked around the same construction expression separately, not instrumented inside full seal

memory.removed_work: full-size target element copy and overlapping replacement coordinate allocation at handoff
memory.retained_owner: same decoded Vec allocation, exact observed count capacity, same request/readers lifetime; small Arc and Vec metadata remain
memory.rss_limitation: unchanged diagnostic independently exercises original target Arc-slice conversion in both arms; process RSS/HWM includes that allocation, fixture and allocator effects and cannot isolate full-preparation peak or candidate RSS savings

limitations: No physical robot, map activation RPC, actor queue latency or full-runtime latency measurement
No concurrency, source-Vec change, long-lived cache, new guard, limits, scoring, heading acceptance or error changes
100k-target/250k-source aggregate control has mixed ratios including a 15.6% paired regression and a 19.749 microsecond higher aggregate median; no universal speedup claim
The existing sparse wrong-heading regression passed unchanged; this does not diagnose or fix a reported field heading reversal
Independent stage timers are not additive attribution
